== Summary ==
Identified: [[Nathan Davis]] (blue Seattle cap and a Seahawks hoodie; same face and cap as [[:File:Nathan Davis 2025 World Championship.jpg]], where the cap is on a Mariners jersey) and [[Jack Douglass]] (hair in a bun, glasses, a beard, and a black sunset-graphic tee; same face as his named 2025 Worlds photographs, and the same shirt as [[:File:2025 Oregon State Championship 4.jpg]]). Remaining faces unlabeled, including the player in a green plaid shirt and a beard; the heavy-set player in a dark grey shirt, seen from behind; the balding player in a navy tee and glasses; and the standing player in a grey zip hoodie, glasses, and a beard (the same person as [[:File:2025 Oregon State Championship 3.jpg]] and the JUSTIN M / joyjoy Advocate Award card in [[:File:2025 Oregon State Championship 4.jpg]]).

Players at the 2025 Oregon State Championship in a private basement in Portland (21 June 2025).

* '''Event:''' [[2025 State Championships]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2026-04-11
* '''Camera date:''' 2025-06-21
* '''Identification:''' [[Nathan Davis]] (blue Seattle cap and a Seahawks hoodie; same face and cap as [[:File:Nathan Davis 2025 World Championship.jpg]], where the cap is on a Mariners jersey) and [[Jack Douglass]] (hair in a bun, glasses, a beard, and a black sunset-graphic tee; same face as his named 2025 Worlds photographs, and the same shirt as [[:File:2025 Oregon State Championship 4.jpg]]). Remaining faces unlabeled, including the player in a green plaid shirt and a beard; the heavy-set player in a dark grey shirt, seen from behind; the balding player in a navy tee and glasses; and the standing player in a grey zip hoodie, glasses, and a beard (the same person as [[:File:2025 Oregon State Championship 3.jpg]] and the JUSTIN M / joyjoy Advocate Award card in [[:File:2025 Oregon State Championship 4.jpg]]).
